option_relations.rationale: The option specifies 'other than heart block', while the leaf diagnosis explicitly includes intermittent complete heart block and trifascicular block, which are types of heart block.

The option describes 'Trifascicular block (Right bundle-branch block with alternating left anterior and left posterior fascicular block)', which is a key component and a subtype of the broader diagnosis of 'Syncope due to intermittent complete heart block (Stokes-Adams attack) secondary to trifascicular block (RBBB, alternating LAFB/LPFB, and first-degree AV block)'.

The option 'Intermittent complete heart block (e.g., trifascicular block progression)' is essentially equivalent to the core diagnostic component of the leaf, 'Syncope due to intermittent complete heart block (Stokes-Adams attack) secondary to trifascicular block (RBBB, alternating LAFB/LPFB, and first-degree AV block)'.
The option 'High-grade atrioventricular (AV) block' is a broader category that includes 'intermittent complete heart block', which is a central part of the leaf diagnosis.
